title: Vite: dev server, build and environment variables

videos.script:
Vite has run under everything since lesson one. Today you look at what it actually does.

{{dev}} First the development server. It does not build anything: each file is translated when the browser asks, and only the dependencies are bundled ahead. And the flag lesson one promised, host, to open the planner on a phone.

{{build}} Then a build, file by file: an index page rewritten, assets with hashes in their names, and the public folder copied as it is.

{{maps}} Then source maps, the key that turns minified code back into yours, and the choice between publishing that key and keeping it.

{{env}} And last, environment variables. Only the ones whose names start with VITE reach the browser, and those are written into the code at build time, where anybody can read them. So a secret is never one.
